conceptPrompt:
Create a world-class product design presentation of THREE RADICALLY DISTINCT native Wear OS voice-agent apps for a ROUND Google Pixel Watch. This is a high fidelity UI concept sheet, not existing app screenshots. Landscape canvas 3:2. Three large perfect circular screens in one clean row, each with one small name below. Dark charcoal neutral presentation background, no watches, straps, hands, device mockups, perspective, or promotional headlines. Each circle should fill its column and remain completely legible.

The user strongly rejected basic Android button stacks, terminal grids, notebook slogans, simple orbit outlines, oversized 'Let's think it through' text and identical recolored layouts. Give this the visual quality of top-tier industrial interface design: thoughtful custom symbols, sophisticated depth, expressive material, constrained type, impeccable optical alignment, sparse useful controls. Every interactive target at least 48dp at a 228dp diameter; functional minimal watch UIs, not decorative posters. No mascots. No invented real messages or fake active jobs. Use only a tiny 'Offline' status when needed.

LEFT / CODEX: precisely engineered white-on-graphite mission control. A sculptural segmented white woven knot/command sculpture at center upper, finely lit like a real premium object, occupying only 25% screen; small 'codex' title at top. Distinct asymmetrical control composition: a strong luminous ivory capsule with terminal prompt glyph and 'New task', offset compact rounded-square history button with stacked-line glyph, subtle 'Recent tasks' footer affordance. Restrained graphite layers, warm-white contrasts, tiny electric-lime connection dot. Think refined hardware instrument, never a green hacker grid. Make the code-agent identity immediate without paragraphs.

MIDDLE / CLAUDE: tactile expressive amber intelligence, almost entirely warm near-black espresso OLED background with large sculptural coral / terracotta multi-ray asterisk softly illuminated, appearing like folded silk or hand-shaped clay, beautiful organic irregularity; quiet cream serif 'Claude' upper-left/upper-center. Primary action is an elegant circular warm-white microphone control integrated at lower right of a soft irregular terracotta conversation surface. Compact readable 'Start a conversation' in cream aligned left, with a subtle history-tab tucked at lower left. NOT a beige full-page notebook, not a big generic pill. Warm material, generous calm negative space, thoughtful asymmetry.

RIGHT / GROKBOT: daring monochrome optical design. Black AMOLED void, tilted liquid-chrome slash / glint as the main composition across center, strong geometric white 'grok' wordmark small near top. Bold circular black microphone button embedded into a glossy off-white crescent sweeping along the lower-right edge, crisp but not bulky. 'Ask Grok' small at lower center, two minimal compact history/settings controls naturally distributed across the lower arc. No blue orbit rings, no generic spaceship HUD. Dramatic brushed silver and glass, confident minimalism.

Use actual readable microcopy and correctly drawn microphone/history/settings icons. Each screen must have clear voice-entry, history and settings affordances with enough separation for touch. Respect circular safe zones: 18dp inset, top/bottom narrow bounds; no cropped words. Typography is SMALL and refined, control labels readable, never giant marketing slogans. These are three different visual systems and different spatial layouts. Render clean pixel-perfect production-intent UI, high resolution.
